scope: Independent static protocol/code review; did not train models or inspect test inputs/outcomes. Executor reports synthetic selftests passed.
findings: Primary final macro recall and paired-seed bootstrap predefined; 10 paired algorithmic seeds are not population replication.
Empty old-class metric is null; current-pair acquisition aggregation and support thresholds predefined.
Shared streams, candidates, reservoir and isolated policy RNG; fresh examples inserted once after training.
All arms run equal virtual and real update counts, fresh/replay sizes, and pre/post candidate scoring. No deployment efficiency claim warranted.
Finite gradients, probability checks, deterministic synthetic tests, shape/label checks and all pairwise split duplicate checks implemented.
Hash freeze must precede opening official test; immutable one-run policy and no test-informed tuning.
Use external 600-second timeout; final cooperative time/RSS guards leave incomplete failures.
